editorial:
You get to see how Mike and Sulley first met at Monsters University, and they weren't friends at first. Mike is a small, hardworking monster who studies hard to become a scarer, while Sulley is a big, natural talent who coasts on his family name. Their rivalry turns into an unlikely friendship when they're forced to team up in a fraternity. The vibe is fun, colorful, and full of college humor that both kids and adults will enjoy.

The animation looks amazing, with tons of detail in every scene. The voice acting is top-notch, especially Billy Crystal and John Goodman. The pacing keeps things moving with plenty of laughs. On the downside, the story feels a bit predictable and doesn't quite reach the emotional heights of the first movie. Still, it's a great pick for families and fans of the original. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Mike and Sulley get expelled from Monsters University after breaking into the human world. They start working in the mailroom at Monsters Inc. and slowly work their way up to the scare floor. The twist is that their failure at school actually leads them to their dream jobs, showing that success doesn't always follow a straight path. They eventually become the best scare team, setting up the events of the first movie.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves animated family comedies and Pixar movies.
